rules.name: Temporary files
rules.why: Apps leave temporary files behind and rarely clean them up.
rules.rebuild: Nothing is rebuilt. An app that still needs a temporary file creates a new one.

rules.name: Application crash dumps
rules.why: Memory dumps written when apps crashed. They are only useful for diagnosing those crashes.
rules.rebuild: Nothing is rebuilt. You lose the ability to send these dumps to a developer.

rules.name: Windows Error Reporting archive
rules.why: Copies of error reports that Windows has already processed.
rules.rebuild: Nothing is rebuilt. Reliability Monitor may show less detail for past problems.

rules.name: Explorer thumbnail cache
rules.why: Saved previews of pictures and videos shown in File Explorer.
rules.rebuild: Explorer recreates thumbnails as you browse folders; the first visit to large folders is slower.

rules.name: DirectX shader cache
rules.why: Compiled graphics shaders kept to speed up games and 3D apps.
rules.rebuild: Games and apps recompile shaders; their next launches may stutter or load slower.

rules.name: NVIDIA DirectX shader cache
rules.why: Compiled graphics shaders kept by the NVIDIA driver.
rules.rebuild: The driver recompiles shaders; the next launches of games may stutter or load slower.

rules.name: Google Chrome cache
rules.why: Copies of web pages, images and scripts Chrome has downloaded.
rules.rebuild: Chrome downloads pages again as you visit them; sites load slower at first. Sign-ins and history are not stored here.

rules.name: Microsoft Edge cache
rules.why: Copies of web pages, images and scripts Edge has downloaded.
rules.rebuild: Edge downloads pages again as you visit them; sites load slower at first. Sign-ins and history are not stored here.

rules.name: npm package cache
rules.why: Downloaded JavaScript packages kept by npm.
rules.rebuild: npm downloads packages again the next time a project installs them, which needs a network connection.

rules.name: NuGet download cache
rules.why: Package metadata and downloads kept by NuGet.
rules.rebuild: NuGet downloads them again on the next restore, which needs a network connection.

rules.name: Google Chrome script cache
rules.why: Compiled website scripts Chrome keeps so pages start faster.
rules.rebuild: Chrome compiles scripts again as you visit sites; pages may start a little slower at first. Sign-ins and history are not stored here.

rules.name: Microsoft Edge script cache
rules.why: Compiled website scripts Edge keeps so pages start faster.
rules.rebuild: Edge compiles scripts again as you visit sites; pages may start a little slower at first. Sign-ins and history are not stored here.

rules.name: Mozilla Firefox cache
rules.why: Copies of web pages, images and scripts Firefox has downloaded.
rules.rebuild: Firefox downloads pages again as you visit them; sites load slower at first. Bookmarks, history and sign-ins are kept in the roaming profile, not here.

rules.name: Mozilla Firefox startup cache
rules.why: Precompiled parts of Firefox itself, kept to start faster.
rules.rebuild: Firefox rebuilds it on its next start, which may take a moment longer.

rules.name: Discord cache
rules.why: Copies of images, avatars and other files Discord has downloaded.
rules.rebuild: Discord downloads them again as you browse servers and chats. Your account, messages and settings are not stored here.

rules.name: Discord script cache
rules.why: Compiled scripts of the Discord app, kept to start faster.
rules.rebuild: Discord compiles them again on its next start, which may take a moment longer.

rules.name: Steam web cache
rules.why: Copies of store and community pages the Steam client has shown.
rules.rebuild: Steam downloads the pages again as you open them. Games, saves and your sign-in are not stored here.

rules.name: Visual Studio Code compiled code cache
rules.why: Compiled code of Visual Studio Code and its extensions, kept to start faster. Old versions are left behind after updates.
rules.rebuild: Visual Studio Code rebuilds it on its next start, which may take a moment longer. Settings and extensions are not stored here.

rules.name: Visual Studio Code extension downloads
rules.why: Downloaded extension packages kept after they were installed.
rules.rebuild: Nothing is rebuilt. Installed extensions keep working; an extension is downloaded again only if it is reinstalled.

rules.name: pip package cache
rules.why: Downloaded Python packages kept by pip.
rules.rebuild: pip downloads packages again the next time they are installed, which needs a network connection.

rules.name: Yarn package cache
rules.why: Downloaded JavaScript packages kept by Yarn.
rules.rebuild: Yarn downloads packages again the next time a project installs them, which needs a network connection.

rules.name: Go build cache
rules.why: Compiled Go packages kept to speed up later builds.
rules.rebuild: Go rebuilds packages on the next build, which is slower once. It is the same cache `go clean -cache` empties.

rules.name: Store apps' temporary files
rules.why: Temporary files of apps from the Microsoft Store. Windows treats this folder as disposable and may empty it at any time.
rules.rebuild: Nothing is rebuilt. An app that still needs a temporary file creates a new one.
